responsibility: Implements the IA-64 target’s C-family front-end hooks for HP-UX-specific pragma handling. Its main job is to parse `#pragma builtin` directives and, when strict C89 mode is in force, map declarations of selected libm entry points to alternate HP-UX runtime symbol names that preserve required `errno`/matherr behavior, by adding identifier renamings through the C pragma machinery rather than changing backend code generation.
